objects.name: The Wick-Saints' Post
objects.vInscr: Moths pool beneath the flame like water. They are praying, in their way.

Chalked Waystone
objects.vInscr: Kindled by pilgrims. Touch it, and every lit waystone on the Hide knows your step.

landmarks.name: The Deposed Sovereign
landmarks.inscription: They crowned the god to make of it a king. A king can be pulled down.

landmarks.name: The Needle of Struck Names
landmarks.inscription: Every name the god was called was cut here, and every name was cut away. The chains came after, when the names began to return.

landmarks.name: The Unfaced Saint
landmarks.inscription: Its own order took the face away, lest the pilgrims learn to whom they had been praying.

landmarks.name: She of the Six Gifts
landmarks.inscription: Each hand held out one gift. The faithful broke off the two they could no longer bear to be given.
